lines: Morning in Greymere. Light through the shutters, the smell of the hearth, and somebody's goats complaining in the distance.

morning_wake.speaker: Kai
lines: ...That's a lot of goats.
That's Joey's ma's goats. That's all of Joey's ma's goats.
Bread, a knife and a note in Lena's hand:
EAT SOMETHING.
She has underlined it twice. You eat something.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: Ma says I'm too young to go near the Court. I say I'm too young to muck out the goat pen either, but here we are.
You're not going up there, are you? To the arch?

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: Kai! Before you say anything, I want you to know I had a plan.

joey_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: Where are the goats, Joey.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: The plan was that the gate would stay shut.
It's a very simple plan. The gate let me down.

joey_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: How many?

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: All of them. Technically. They're in Silas's orchard. Technically also eating it.
It takes the better part of an hour. Joey is enthusiastic and almost no help. The last goat surrenders under the pear tree.

joey_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Joey. Kai. Goats.
Three things I didn't want to see before breakfast.

joey_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Since you're both up and already out of breath: lesson. Kai first. Joey, you're holding the goats.
Guard up. If you two are going to be stupid, you'll be stupid with your guard up.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: Danfor's waiting on you. I'd go before he decides I need a lesson too.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: So. Funny thing. I may have bet a traveller that you could beat the Wandering Challenger.
Twice. In one day. On the south road.
He's very confident. I was more confident. Please don't make me a liar.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: The Challenger's out on Route 01, east of the tall grass. Beat him once and I'll set up the rematch.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: You beat him! He wants a rematch, which, between us, is how I win the bet.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: Twice in one day. I'm a genius. You're also fine, I suppose.
Half the winnings are yours. A third. A generous quarter.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: Did you feel that, last night? The ground did a thing.
It's fine. It's probably fine. Nobody go up the ridge, that's all.

joey_talk.speaker: Joey
lines: They're putting a fence round the ridge. Round the whole... round the ridge.
No reason. I just like the ridge. As a ridge.

spar_later.speaker: Danfor
lines: Take your minute. I'll be by the south road. The goats and I aren't going anywhere.

danfor_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Morning, Kai. If you see Joey, tell him I can hear goats. Tell him I can hear them from here.

danfor_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Lesson's still on. Basic, Signature, Gambit, Brace. And watch me when I wind up.

danfor_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Road's open. Trainers out there mostly want a bout and a story to tell about it.
When somebody winds up for something big, Brace. When they're weak to what you're swinging, they'll stagger.

danfor_talk.speaker: Danfor
lines: Dogs won't stop barking at the hill. Silas won't stop looking at it.
I'd take the dogs.

after_spar.speaker: Danfor
lines: Not bad. You hit like somebody who'd rather not, which is the right instinct and the wrong habit.

after_spar.speaker: Kai
lines: Is that a pass?

after_spar.speaker: Danfor
lines: It's a pass. South road's open. Take a potion, keep your guard up, and come home before dark.

after_spar.speaker: Joey
lines: The goats are back in the pen, by the way. You're welcome. Mostly you're welcome.

south_road_closed.speaker: Danfor
lines: Not before your lesson, Kai! Square, by the south road. I'll find you.

ferris_talk.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: Someone's got to keep the lamps lit and walk the rounds. Forty years now, give or take.
Quiet town, Greymere. I intend to keep it that way as long as this torch holds out.

ferris_talk.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: You'll be heading down the south road, I expect. Mind the west clearing.
Old Greymaw's walking again. Grey wolf, older than the road. Comes down off the ridge before the frost.
Eyes like lamp-glass this year. Never seen him bold like this.

ferris_talk.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: West clearing, then south through the hedge where it's torn. You'll see his marks. You'll smell him first.

ferris_talk.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: You did WHAT?
...Well. Keep that fang. It remembers the ridge, that one. So will you.

ferris_talk.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: Lamps are lit. Not that it helps, some nights.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: Feverbalm, willowbark, a little dried nettle for the swelling. Nothing fancy, but it keeps Greymere on its feet.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: Did you eat? The note was not decorative, Kai.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: Sit. No, sit. Danfor's lessons always end in a scrape.

lena_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: It's nothing.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: It's nothing because I'm cleaning it. Was Joey involved?

lena_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: There were goats.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: There are always goats. Tell him the next one he loses, he finds himself.
While you're on the road, bring me marshwort from the pond. Green, flat leaves. Not the ones that smell.

lena_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: Which ones smell?

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: You'll know.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: Marshwort. The reeds on Route 01, by the pond. You'll know.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: That's the right one. You did know.
Here. Clearwater, for a hex or a fever. Don't save it for a special occasion.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: If Danfor sends you home with a black eye, I'm sending him a bill.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: The spring tastes of iron and half the town has a headache. I've run out of willowbark.
Have you eaten? You haven't. Sit.

lena_talk.speaker: Lena
lines: Eat. Then sleep. Then you can tell me about Civara.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: I was younger than you when they sealed that arch. My grandfather was younger than me.
Strange, how well that worked, right up until it didn't.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Kai. Close the door.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Have you been near the old ridge? Up past the arch. Lately.

silas_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: ...No. Why?

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Stay off the ridge for a while. Humour an old man.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: It's waking up. I don't know what else to call it.
Don't look at me like that. I'm not a child either.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Don't ask me about the Warden, Kai. Not today.

silas_talk.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: I've seen that light before. Once. A long time ago.
No. That's all you get. That's all I've got.

silas_goats.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Good. Let them. Goats are allowed to be curious.
If you feel the ground hum up there, or anything else that isn't the wind, you come and tell me.

silas_should.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: No. You shouldn't. That's the answer.
If you feel the ground hum, or anything else that isn't the wind, you come and tell me. Before you tell Joey.

gell_talk.speaker: Gell
lines: Kai! Just the man. You've heard about Civara? Course you haven't. Nobody here reads.

gell_talk.speaker: Gell
lines: Biggest city in Avelan. Every second person a Duelist, and every Duelist with a Crest the size of a dinner plate.
Throw fire, walk through walls. One fellow turned into a lion. Or had a lion. One of the two.

gell_talk.speaker: Kai
lines: You've been?

gell_talk.speaker: Gell
lines: I've been near. I've talked to people who've been. Which is better, because they tell you the good parts.
Behind you, Joey admires a brass thimble. Then the brass thimble is no longer on the shelf.

gell_talk.speaker: Gell
lines: Now. Favour. The inn wants a crate of lamp oil and I'd rather not carry it. It's by the door. Senna's paying.

gell_thimble.speaker: Joey
lines: ...I was going to pay for this. With money. That I have.

gell_thimble.speaker: Gell
lines: Put it back, Joey. And Kai, favour.
The inn wants a crate of lamp oil and I'd rather not carry it. It's by the door. Senna's paying.

senna_talk.speaker: Goodwife Senna
lines: Silas's told you the arch story already, hasn't he. He tells everyone the arch story.
It's a good story. Doesn't mean it's the whole one.

senna_talk.speaker: Goodwife Senna
lines: Gell's oil! Carried by somebody who isn't Gell. That's a first.
Here, for your trouble. Don't tell him I paid you more than he would.

senna_talk.speaker: Goodwife Senna
lines: Breakfast's gone, lunch isn't ready, and Ferris has been telling the wolf story again.

senna_talk.speaker: Goodwife Senna
lines: Lamps are full, thanks to you. Ferris says I'm wasting oil. Ferris can sit in the dark.
That night the ground hums. Not a quake. A note, low enough to feel in your teeth.
By morning every dog in Greymere is barking at the ridge, and the spring water tastes of iron.

abnormal_signs.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Kai.

abnormal_signs.speaker: Kai
lines: You felt it too.

abnormal_signs.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Everyone felt it. Everyone has decided it was the weather.
It isn't the weather.
Two wagons stand in the square with the Avelan seal on their canvas. Survey stakes. Brass instruments. People in navy coats.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Warden Almyra, Avelan Survey Office. We're here to inspect the ground under the ridge.
There's been settling. Nobody's in danger. We'd like to keep it that way.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: Specialist Hale. Instruments, mostly. If you see anything that looks like it costs more than your house, it does. Please don't lean on it.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: ...Warden.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Silas.
It's been a long time.
They look at each other a moment too long. Neither says anything else.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Danfor
lines: Paperwork's in order. Seals and all. I'll put a man on the arch.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Gell
lines: I knew it. Didn't I say? Avelan. I said it.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Lena
lines: You're fencing off half the hill. People forage up there.

almyra_arrives.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: For a few days. I'm sorry for it.
...You're Kai, aren't you?

almyra_arrives.speaker: Kai
lines: How do you know my name?

almyra_arrives.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Small town. Big survey. Stay off the ridge, all of you.

almyra_cordon.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: It's a geological inspection, Kai. Rocks. Very old rocks.
If that were all of it, I wouldn't have come myself. That's all you get.

hale_cordon.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: Readings under the ridge are... loud. Officially: interesting.
We go down at dusk. Procedure. I'm the procedure.

danfor_cordon.speaker: Danfor
lines: Dusk already. Kai, have you seen Joey? His ma says he went out with a sack and a guilty face.
The ground answers before you can. A crack like a door slammed in a cellar, and the ridge sags inward.
Dust rolls down through the arch. Somebody is shouting in Avelan drill-voice.

danfor_cordon.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: Back! Everyone back from the arch!

danfor_cordon.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: The floor went. We had a bonding attempt prepared, and the Court... answered it wrong.
Bonding attempt: unsuccessful. Cause: me.
The passages sealed behind the Warden. There's light down there that shouldn't be.

danfor_cordon.speaker: Danfor
lines: Joey's sack's on the steps. It's empty.

danfor_cordon.speaker: Kai
lines: He went down. For his... things. He's been going down for years.

danfor_cordon.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Kai. Listen to me.
If you hear something calling you, do not answer it.
Silas's warning sits in your chest like a stone. You climb down through the broken arch.
You land hard on cold stone. Above, the breach is a ragged slice of dusk. Below, the stair goes on, lit by a gold that comes from nowhere.

court_stair_arrive.speaker: Kai
lines: Joey?
...Joey!
The name comes back three times from three directions. None of them sound like you.

gallery_almyra.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Kai? Of course it's you. Of course it is.
Almyra is half under a fallen statue, shield arm free, sword arm not. The water beside her moves without wind.

gallery_almyra.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Don't lift that. Something's using the stone. It's going to stand up.
The statue's twin, across the water, turns its broken head toward you.

gallery_almyra.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Shield's free. Get me a moment and I'll get us both out of this.

gallery_almyra_freed.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: That's twice I owe Greymere something today. I hate owing.

gallery_almyra_freed.speaker: Kai
lines: Joey's down here.

gallery_almyra_freed.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Then we find Joey. The far passage, past the water. The light's strongest that way.
Stay behind my shield when you can, and in front of it when you can't.

chamber_joey.speaker: Joey
lines: Kai! Before you say anything, I want you to know I had a plan!

chamber_joey.speaker: Kai
lines: Was the plan the lights?

chamber_joey.speaker: Joey
lines: The plan was NOT the lights!
Two knots of violet light drift between him and you. The chamber hums like a held breath.

chamber_joey.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Get to him and hold. Don't chase them. Keep them off him until the light settles.

chamber_anchor.speaker: Joey
lines: Thank you. Thank you. I'm never coming down here again. I'm never doing anything again.

chamber_anchor.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: That pillar. The sealed light. It's what's holding the passages shut. Hale's on the other side.

chamber_anchor.speaker: Joey
lines: So we hit the glowing pillar. I can help. I can point.

chamber_anchor.speaker: Kai
lines: Stay down, Joey.
The anchor shatters. The passages groan open. And the gold disc in the floor wakes all at once.
Something is calling. Not your name. Something older than names.

chamber_bond.speaker: Kai
lines: Silas said... don't answer.
You don't answer.
It takes you anyway.
When you can see again, there is light between Joey and the falling stone. Your light.
It holds. Then the chamber cracks from wall to wall.

chamber_choir.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: Warden! The seal broke and the readings went... Kai? Why is the reading coming from Kai?

chamber_choir.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Later. Look at the walls.
The robed statues around the chamber lean inward. Their mouths are open. They are singing.

chamber_choir.speaker: Specialist Hale
lines: The containment rite. It's still running and it thinks we're what it's containing.

chamber_choir.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Joey, behind the plinth. Hale, with me. Kai...
...whatever that is on your hand, use it.
Greymere in grey morning light. Two roofs down in the square, the spring cracked, people sweeping.
Damaged. Standing.

aftermath.speaker: Danfor
lines: Nobody dead. Nobody. I counted twice.

aftermath.speaker: Lena
lines: Kai. Have you eaten?

aftermath.speaker: Lena
lines: Of course you haven't.

aftermath.speaker: Joey
lines: I'm going to change. I mean it this time. I'm going to be a completely different person.
Starting tomorrow. Probably.

aftermath.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: Let me see your hand.
The mark on the back of your hand catches the light. Every colour. Then none.

aftermath.speaker: Elder Silas
lines: I've seen that light before. Once.
No. Don't ask me where. Not yet.

aftermath.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Kai. Walk with me.
My specialists tried for an hour. The Crest isn't on you. It's in you. Taking it out would kill you.

aftermath.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: So now there are two legal roads, and I need you to understand both of them.

custody_terms.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Permanent protective custody. A safe house, a staff, researchers. Restricted movement.
You'd be looked after. You would not be let go.

custody_why.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Avelan noticed resonance under the town. That's true.
There's more, and I'm not going to tell you it today. Not because it's yours to fear. Because it's mine to carry.

custody_records.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: There was a quiet survey here when you were a child. Your result was... inconclusive. Contradictory.
I'd seen your name. I didn't know it would be you. Nobody did.

custody_classification.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Duelist classification. Civara. Training, monitored travel, the Trial.
In time, an independent licence. It's the harder road, and it's yours more than the other one is.

custody_classification.speaker: Kai
lines: If I take it, can I leave? If it turns out to be the wrong road?

custody_classification.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: ...There's a petition clause. Almost nobody uses it.

custody_classification.speaker: Kai
lines: Write it down. With my name on it.

custody_menu.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Ask.

custody_decided.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: In writing. You're harder to protect than you look, you know that?

custody_decided.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: The north road, then. Civara. I'll ride with you as far as the Hall.
Joey waves until the road bends. Lena doesn't wave; she's packed you lunch, which is the same thing.

danfor_aftermath.speaker: Danfor
lines: Two roofs and a spring. We'll rebuild the roofs. The spring can fix itself.

joey_aftermath.speaker: Joey
lines: Completely different person. You'll see. Tomorrow.

almyra_aftermath.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Whenever you're ready, Kai. Not before.
Civara. Stone on stone on stone, six storeys high, with people in every window.
A woman on the corner lights a lamp with a flick of Crest-fire. Nobody turns to look.

civara_arrive.speaker: Kai
lines: Nobody's even looking.

civara_arrive.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Here, that's ordinary. You're not.
Three departments have already asked to borrow you. I've said no to all of them, politely, in writing.

civara_arrive.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: The Hall's through the arch. Report to the clerk. I'll be close.

civara_clerk.speaker: Clerk
lines: Registrants through the arch. Resonance testing in order of arrival.
You're the Greymere case? Then you're in order of arrival and also a memo.

almyra_civara.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: In Greymere I was the authority. Here I'm one desk of many. Mind which desks you trust.

civara_stall.speaker: Stall Keeper
lines: Tonics, salves, a better price than Gell's. Don't tell Gell.

liora_hall.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: Liora Sen, Prudentian consultancy. I'm here for the resonance, not for you.
No offence. You're very interesting adjacent to it.

liora_hall.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: Six channels. Six. And then you chose one, and it listened.
I'll be writing about this for a year.

civara_classification.speaker: Clerk
lines: Hand on the plate, please. Breathe normally. It will tell us which pattern your Crest settles into.
Six columns of glass light up along the wall. Crimson. Azure. Ember. Eclipse. Glass. Verdant.
All six. At once.

civara_classification.speaker: Clerk
lines: ...That's a fault. Again, please.
All six. Again.

civara_classification.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It isn't a fault. Don't touch the plate. Don't touch anything. Look at it.

civara_classification.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: It answers everything because nothing has told it what it is yet. Kai. You can tell it.

civara_classification.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: Pick one and hold it. Stabilise it. It'll be yours, and you'll be its, and that's that.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Crimson column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_warrior.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_warrior.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Azure column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_guardian.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_guardian.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Ember column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_mage.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_mage.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Eclipse column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_sorcerer.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_sorcerer.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Glass column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_assassin.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_assassin.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.
You hold one pattern and let the others go. The Verdant column burns steady. The rest go dark.

civara_chosen_neutral.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: It listened. It actually listened.

civara_chosen_neutral.speaker: Assessor
lines: Then it can be assessed. Same pattern as yours, Greymere. Different habits. Show me what you'll do with it.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Hall first, assessment after. The clerk is waiting.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

assessor_hall.speaker: Assessor
lines: Ready when you are, Greymere.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_assess_retry.speaker: Assessor
lines: Again? Good. Nobody passes by quitting.

civara_after.speaker: Assessor
lines: Pass. Rough, and yours. Classification confirmed.

civara_after.speaker: Liora Sen
lines: I'll need to see that again. Many, many times. For science.

civara_after.speaker: Warden Almyra
lines: Welcome to Civara, Duelist. The hard part starts tomorrow.

civara_after.speaker: Kai
lines: ...Tomorrow's fine.
